method: Directly opened Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary entry pages with line locators; Cambridge publisher-owned indexed search results observed but direct entry opens returned HTTP 403. Topic labels are not headword-specific CEFR ratings. This is independent-source research BY THE ASSISTANT, not independent human editorial review.

frozen.english_definition: The process of learning skills needed for a job or activity.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge publisher-index labels the uncountable work-skills noun B1, versus provisional A2. Oxford directly confirms the job-skills noun and uncountability; its Jobs a2 topic label is not a headword CEFR badge.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: The process of learning skills needed for a job or activity.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: အလုပ် သို့မဟုတ် လုပ်ငန်းတစ်ခုအတွက် လိုအပ်သော ကျွမ်းကျင်မှုများကို လေ့ကျင့်သင်ယူခြင်း
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: New employees receive safety training before starting work.

frozen.english_definition: A structure with a roof and walls.
frozen.burmese_meaning: အဆောက်အအုံ
frozen.example_sentence: The new building has six floors.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge publisher-index labels the countable physical-structure noun A2. Do not confuse the building (structure) noun with the uncountable process of building or the -ing verb form of build.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: A structure with a roof and walls.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: နံရံများနှင့် ခေါင်မိုးပါသော အဆောက်အအုံ
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The new school building has six classrooms.

frozen.english_definition: The activity of giving information about events.
frozen.burmese_meaning: သတင်းတင်ပြခြင်း၊ အစီရင်ခံခြင်း
frozen.example_sentence: Accurate reporting helps the public understand events.

entries.editorial_risk: Oxford directly describes an uncountable noun about preparing and presenting news, with a TV/radio/news b2 TOPIC label only. Cambridge publisher-index business/accounting reporting has no exact-sense B2 badge. The frozen definition is too broad for the Oxford news-specific sense.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: The activity of giving information about events.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: သတင်းဖြစ်ရပ်များကို သတင်းစာ၊ ရေဒီယို သို့မဟုတ် ရုပ်မြင်သံကြားတွင် ရေးသားတင်ပြခြင်း
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: Accurate reporting helps readers understand what happened.

frozen.english_definition: A person who designs or maintains machines, structures, or systems.
frozen.burmese_meaning: အင်ဂျင်နီယာ
frozen.example_sentence: The engineer inspected the damaged bridge.

entries.editorial_risk: Oxford directly confirms the design/build profession noun, while its Jobs a2 and Engineering a2 TOPIC tags do not establish exact-sense A2. Cambridge indexed definition has no visible exact-sense B2 badge. Do not equate engineer (person) with engine (machine), or the distinct engine-driver sense.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: A person who designs or maintains machines, structures, or systems.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: စက်ပစ္စည်းများ၊ အဆောက်အအုံများနှင့် စနစ်များကို ဒီဇိုင်းရေးဆွဲ တည်ဆောက်သည့် အင်ဂျင်နီယာပညာရှင်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: An engineer designed the new bridge.

frozen.english_definition: A person who gives a talk to an audience.
frozen.burmese_meaning: ပရိသတ်ရှေ့တွင် ဟောပြောသူ
frozen.example_sentence: The guest speaker answered questions after the lecture.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge publisher-index labels the public-talk person noun B1, versus provisional B2. Oxford directly distinguishes speech-giver, language-speaker, electronic loudspeaker and parliamentary Speaker; its b2 topic tag belongs to electronics, not this frozen public-talk sense.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: A person who gives a talk to an audience.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: ပရိသတ်ရှေ့တွင် မိန့်ခွန်း သို့မဟုတ် ဟောပြောချက် ပြောကြားသူ
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The guest speaker answered questions after the talk.

frozen.english_definition: New information about events happening now or recently.
frozen.burmese_meaning: သတင်း၊ နောက်ဆုံးဖြစ်ရပ်အကြောင်းအရာ
frozen.example_sentence: We heard the news on the radio this morning.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge publisher-index labels recent-events information noun A2 and notes it is uncountable with singular agreement. News is NOT a productive plural of adjective new; do not auto-ban it as a duplicate lexical slot. Oxford news topic labels are not headword-specific CEFR badges.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: New information about events happening now or recently.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: မကြာသေးမီက ဖြစ်ပျက်ခဲ့သော အကြောင်းအရာများနှင့်ပတ်သက်သည့် သတင်းအချက်အလက်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: We heard some good news this morning.
